verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a REST API for submitting video generation jobs, including prompt-to-video on POST /v3/models/videos and text-prompt video creation with avatar and voice control. It also claims a quick path from API key to first video, and the llms.txt probe confirms a live developer documentation surface. The retrieval half of the story is only implied, through the webhooks bundled with the batch APIs and the 'first video' quickstart claim. Missing for 10: an explicitly cited status-polling or download endpoint for the finished asset, a reachable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404 despite the 'typed schemas' claim), and independent hands-on corroboration of the submit-and-retrieve flow.
